Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Kinsley Dining Chair, 37.5"H, Set of 2, Washed Denim
Colors: Washed Denim
This set of 2 gorgeous wingback dining chairs lend an air of classic elegance to any room or occasion, and the washed denim upholstery brings an element of casual, homespun charm to even the most formal design motifs. Solid wood frame for long-lasting support with upholstered fabric and nailhead details Product Dimensions: 26.5"D x 25"W x 37.5"H
